issue: parse_config() truncates values that contain '=': 'url = https://x.test/?a=1&b=2' gives 'https://x.test/?a' instead of the whole URL. Only the first '=' separates the key from the value.
commit: Split config lines on the first '=' only
diff:
--- a/config.py
+++ b/config.py
@@ -5,6 +5,6 @@
         line = line.strip()
         if not line or line.startswith("#"):
             continue
-        parts = line.split("=")
-        out[parts[0].strip()] = parts[1].strip()
+        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
+        out[key.strip()] = value.strip()
     return out
